name: JUNE
description: Individual-based epidemic model of England calibrated to census and survey data, representing approximately 53 million individuals in realistic social settings including households, schools, workplaces, care homes, pubs, and supermarkets. Each agent has demographic attributes, health conditions, and activity patterns drawn from real data. Used for COVID-19 pandemic analysis and health inequality research. Published in Royal Society Open Science (2021).
general_score_metric: agreement with observed epidemiological time series / scenario fit (e.g., RMSE or log-likelihood of simulated vs observed cases/hospitalisations/deaths, plus policy outcome metrics)
reputation: Highly detailed nationally-calibrated ABM; published in Royal Society Open Science; used for UK COVID-19 policy analysis
notes: JUNE stands for Joint UNiversities Epidemic model. Open source on GitHub. Models the full English population at individual level. Calibrated to Census 2011 and UK Time Use Survey. Published in Royal Society Open Science, 2021.

institutions: IDAS (Institute for Data Science and AI, Durham)
